candidats.description: Project manager, Glen Vita, reads the manutfacturer's label from a 100-year old induction motor. The nearly century old water intake on the river north of Sacramento is being replaced, making way for a new intake and fish screen facility designed to protect threatened and endangered fish species while also providing improved water supply reliability for eastern Yolo County. candidats.description: When disaster strikes, we are there. We help people caught up in natural disasters and conflict - typically by providing clean water, food and sanitation in disaster zones. As far as we can, we strive to ensure that civilians are protected too. We also seek to reduce the risk to poor people of future disasters by continuing to work with them long after the immediate crisis is over, and through long-term efforts to build people's resilience to shocks. candidats.titre: File:Antigua bomba de agua en la Escuela N°433 República del Paraguay (Oasis, Misiones, Argentina).jpg
candidats.description: Bomba de agua argentina antigua marca "Bola" en la Escuela N°433 República del Paraguay (Oasis, Provincia de Misiones, Argentina). Las bombas de agua argentinas antiguas, especialmente las de la marca Bola, eran muy comunes y se utilizaban para extraer agua de pozos o fuentes, a menudo en zonas rurales. Estas bombas, de estilo manual y con palanca, eran un símbolo de la vida cotidiana en Argentina y se pueden encontrar hoy en día como objetos de colección o decoración.
